Episodes.Title: In Throes of Increasing Wonder...
Episodes.Writer: Rolin Jones, Anne Rice, Ben Philippe
Episodes.Actors: Jacob Anderson, Sam Reid, Eric Bogosian
Episodes.Plot: Louis meets the vampire Lestat in 1910 New Orleans.

Episodes.Title: ... After the Phantoms of Your Former Self
Episodes.Writer: Jonathan Ceniceroz, David B. Harris, Anne Rice
Episodes.Actors: Jacob Anderson, Sam Reid, Eric Bogosian
Episodes.Plot: Louis learns vampire rules from Lestat.

Episodes.Title: Is My Very Nature That of a Devil
Episodes.Writer: Rolin Jones, Hannah Moscovitch, Anne Rice
Episodes.Actors: Jacob Anderson, Sam Reid, Bailey Bass
Episodes.Plot: Louis grapples in a fight to retain some semblance of his humanity while struggling to identify the true nature of the identity of a vampire and the urges that come with it. Things escalate and soon take a turn for the worst.

Episodes.Title: ...The Ruthless Pursuit of Blood with All a Child's Demanding
Episodes.Writer: Eleanor Burgess, Anne Rice, Rolin Jones
Episodes.Actors: Jacob Anderson, Sam Reid, Bailey Bass
Episodes.Plot: Claudia's transformation into a vampire teen completely changes Louis and Lestat's lives. Louis and Lestat are forced to confront questions about making a teen vampire. Claudia learns dark realities of her new life.

Episodes.Title: A Vile Hunger for Your Hammering Heart
Episodes.Writer: Hannah Moscovitch, Anne Rice, Rolin Jones
Episodes.Actors: Jacob Anderson, Sam Reid, Bailey Bass
Episodes.Plot: Claudia's activities and curiosities present continued challenges for Louis and Lestat. Her actions light an explosive fuse that erupts at episode's end.

Episodes.Title: Like Angels Put in Hell by God
Episodes.Writer: Coline Abert, Anne Rice, Rolin Jones
Episodes.Actors: Jacob Anderson, Sam Reid, Bailey Bass
Episodes.Plot: Louis and Claudia continue trying to include Lestat as a member of the family, but after Lestat interferes too many times, their endurance is pushed to the limit.

Episodes.Title: The Thing Lay Still
Episodes.Writer: Rolin Jones, Ben Philippe, Anne Rice
Episodes.Actors: Jacob Anderson, Sam Reid, Bailey Bass
Episodes.Plot: In the season finale, Claudia's a plan to kill Lestat is so secret, even Louis is not in on the details. But is Lestat one step ahead of her?
